The post is on contract basis under the National Health Mission (NHM) – Mobile Dental Clinic Project. The complete application in the prescribed format, with documents and a demand draft of Rs. 1000/-, must reach the institute in New Delhi by hand or by post on or before 26 November 2026, up to 03:30 PM. Applications opened on 6 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About MAIDS Consultant-Dental Public Health
content_sections.text: Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences is a dental institute of the Govt. of NCT of Delhi, located at the M.A.I.D.S. Complex, B.S. Zafar Marg, New Delhi – 110002. This recruitment is for its Mobile Dental Clinic Project, which runs under the National Health Mission (NHM). The notice is signed by the Medical Officer Incharge (MOI/C), Mobile Dental Clinic Project.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must reach this address, delivered directly by hand or by post: Dept. of Mobile Dental Clinic Project, Room No. 20, Ground Floor, Phase I Building, Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi:110002 The notice describes these steps: Get the prescribed application form from the website www.maids.delhi.gov.in . Applicants must fill in the prescribed form, which is only available on the Institute website. Fill in the form: post applied for, name, father's name, date of birth, age as on 26/11/2026, category, mobile and residence numbers, email ID, permanent and correspondence addresses, qualification, number of years of experience and any other information. Affix a photograph in the box on the form and sign it. Sign the undertaking, which declares that the particulars are true and that the institutions from which the B.D.S/M.D.S/MPH course was passed are recognized. Attach the documents listed under Enclosures, with a Demand Draft of Rs. 1000/- in favour of Mobile Dental Clinic Project . Deliver the complete application by hand or by post so that it reaches the address above on or before 26/11/2026, up to 03:30 PM. The institute will not be responsible for any postal delay on the part of any delivery agency, and applications reaching after the closing date shall not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post, Consultant-Dental Public Health, reserved as Unreserved (UR). The notice lists the programme/division source as the Mobile Dental Clinic Project. B.D.S Degree from recognized university with diploma or degree in Public Health Dentistry/MPH/MDS in Public Health Dentistry. Registered with Delhi Dental Council. Two years experience of working in a Dental College/Hospital/Health System. Essential: Two Years experience of working in a Dental College/Hospital/Health System. The age limit is 45 years as on 30/07/2026, with age relaxation as per rules. The notice does not list the category-wise relaxations. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents to be attached with the application form: Demand Draft Self attested Documents Photo ID proof (Pan Card, Aadhar Card, Voter ID Card etc.) Self attested BDS Marks Cards and Degree Certificate Self attested copy of Internship Completion Certificate, Registration Certificate and mark sheets of B.D.S 1st to 4th Year Self attested MDS/MPH Marks Card and Degree Certificate Valid Delhi State Dental Council Registration Self attested work experience and character certificate Any other additional qualifications

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Competent Authority will scrutinize the applications. Eligible candidates, as per the eligibility criteria and after scrutiny of documents, will appear for a Written Exam and Interview . Details of the Written Exam and Interview will be displayed on the official website subsequently. The call for the exam and interview will be displayed on the Institutional website ( www.maids.delhi.gov.in ). A list of selected candidates as well as wait list candidates will be displayed on www.maids.delhi.gov.in . The decision of the Competent Authority regarding selection will be final, and no representations will be entertained in any circumstances.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Consultant-Dental Public Health, in the UR (Unreserved) category, under the NHM Mobile Dental Clinic Project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the MAIDS Consultant-Dental Public Health application?
faq.answer: The complete application must reach MAIDS on or before 26 November 2026, up to 03:30 PM. Applications reaching after the closing date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: B.D.S Degree from recognized university with diploma or degree in Public Health Dentistry/MPH/MDS in Public Health Dentistry, registration with Delhi Dental Council, and two years experience of working in a Dental College/Hospital/Health System.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years as on 30/07/2026, with age relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of MAIDS Consultant-Dental Public Health?
faq.answer: The consolidated contractual remuneration is Rs. 63,000/- (DSHM share) + Rs. 22,050/- (State share) per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/-, paid by Demand Draft in favour of Mobile Dental Clinic Project and attached with the application form.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed form from www.maids.delhi.gov.in, attach the self-attested documents and the demand draft, and send it by hand or post to Dept. of Mobile Dental Clinic Project, Room No. 20, Ground Floor, Phase I Building, Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi:110002.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will appear for a Written Exam and Interview after scrutiny of documents. Details will be displayed on the official website.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MAIDS Consultant-Dental Public Health post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is on contract basis for the Mobile Dental Clinic Project under NHM, and the incumbent will have no right for regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the written exam or interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA or other allowances will be paid for the interview/screening test or for joining the post.
